Test Steps: Verify Manager can create and assign a new Task
Test Data: 1. Log in as Manager 2. Go to Tasks 3. Click 'Add Task' 4. Fill Title, Description, Priority, Due Date, Assignee 5. Save
Date of execution: Task is successfully created and appears on the assignee's dashboard.

Test Steps: Verify validation when mandatory fields are missing
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Task' 2. Leave 'Title' and 'Assignee' blank 3. Save
Date of execution: System displays validation error indicating missing mandatory fields.

Test Steps: Verify validation when Due Date is set in the past
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Task' 2. Select a past date for Due Date 3. Save
Date of execution: System blocks creation with 'Due Date cannot be in the past' error.

Test Steps: Verify Employee receives notification when assigned a new Task
Test Data: 1. Assign Task to Employee A 2. Employee A logs in and checks notifications
Date of execution: Employee A receives a bell/email notification: 'New task assigned: Prepare Q3 Report'.

Test Steps: Verify Assignee can update Task Status
Test Data: 1. Assignee opens Task 2. Changes status from 'To Do' to 'In Progress'
Date of execution: Task status updates immediately, and moves to 'In Progress' column (if Kanban view).

Test Steps: Verify Assignee can mark Task as Completed
Test Data: 1. Assignee opens Task 2. Changes status to 'Done/Completed'
Date of execution: Task is marked complete and Assignor is notified of the completion.

Test Steps: Verify validation when unauthorized user attempts to update Task Status
Test Data: 1. Log in as Employee B 2. Open a Task assigned to Employee A 3. Attempt to change status
Date of execution: System disables status dropdown or throws 'Permission Denied' error.

Test Steps: Verify Assignee can upload an attachment to the Task
Test Data: 1. Open Task 2. Click 'Attach File' 3. Upload a 2MB PDF/PNG 4. Save
Date of execution: File uploads successfully and is visible to both Assignee and Assignor.

Test Steps: Verify validation when uploading unsupported file format
Test Data: 1. Open Task 2. Click 'Attach File' 3. Upload an executable file (.exe)
Date of execution: System rejects upload and prompts 'Only PDF/Image/Word documents are allowed'.

Test Steps: Verify Assignor and Assignee can add comments to the Task
Test Data: 1. Open Task 2. Type comment in discussion thread 3. Click 'Post'
Date of execution: Comment is posted with timestamp and author name.

Test Steps: Verify Manager can reassign an existing Task
Test Data: 1. Open Task assigned to Employee A 2. Change Assignee to Employee B 3. Save
Date of execution: Task disappears from Employee A's list and appears on Employee B's list.

Test Steps: Verify Employee cannot reassign a Task to someone else (unless permitted)
Test Data: 1. Log in as Assignee (Employee A) 2. Attempt to change Assignee to Employee B
Date of execution: System disables the Assignee field for the task receiver.

Test Steps: Verify Manager can delete a Task they created
Test Data: 1. Manager opens a Task 2. Clicks 'Delete' 3. Confirms prompt
Date of execution: Task is completely removed from the system for both Manager and Assignee.

Test Steps: Verify Employee cannot delete a Task assigned to them by Manager
Test Data: 1. Assignee opens Task 2. Looks for Delete button
Date of execution: Delete button should be hidden or disabled for the Assignee.

Test Steps: Verify filtering Tasks by Status
Test Data: 1. Go to Tasks List 2. Select filter Status = 'In Progress'
Date of execution: Only tasks currently marked as 'In Progress' are displayed.

Test Steps: Verify filtering Tasks by Priority
Test Data: 1. Select filter Priority = 'High'
Date of execution: Only high priority tasks are displayed.

Test Steps: Verify filtering Overdue Tasks
Test Data: 1. Select filter 'Overdue'
Date of execution: Displays only incomplete tasks whose Due Date is in the past.

Test Steps: Verify Kanban Board drag-and-drop functionality
Test Data: 1. Go to Kanban View 2. Drag a task card from 'To Do' and drop in 'In Progress'
Date of execution: Task snaps to the new column and its backend status updates automatically.

Test Steps: Verify Manager can add Subtasks to a Parent Task
Test Data: 1. Open a Parent Task 2. Click 'Add Subtask' 3. Enter details 4. Save
Date of execution: Subtask is created and nested logically under the Parent Task.

Test Steps: Verify Parent Task cannot be marked 'Completed' if Subtasks are pending
Test Data: 1. Attempt to change Parent Task status to 'Completed' while subtasks are 'To Do'
Date of execution: System blocks completion of parent task until all subtasks are marked 'Completed'.

Test Steps: Verify XSS payload in Task Title
Test Data: 1. Create Task 2. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> in Title
Date of execution: System sanitizes input so payload doesn't execute when Assignee views it.

Test Steps: Verify unauthorized access to private tasks
Test Data: 1. Employee A attempts to access Task ID assigned to Employee B (where A is not manager/collaborator)
Date of execution: System returns '403 Forbidden' and blocks access.
